items.name: utils
items.title: cn() and variants
items.description: Class name merging (clsx + tailwind-merge, aware of the SAP token utilities) and cva variants.

items.name: theme
items.title: SAP Horizon theme
items.description: SAP theme tokens for Tailwind v4: Horizon, Horizon Dark, Horizon HC Black and Horizon HC White, the 72 and SAP icon fonts, density and state variants.

items.name: content-density
items.title: Content Density
items.description: Sets cozy, compact or condensed density on an element and its subtree.

items.name: icon
items.title: Icon
items.description: Icons from the SAP-icons, SAP-icons-TNT and Business Suite fonts.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Standard, emphasized, ghost, positive, negative, attention and transparent buttons, toggle and menu buttons, badges.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: Standard, emphasized, subtle, undecorated and inverted links, with icons.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Image, initials or icon avatars in five sizes, with accent and indication colours, zoom icon and value states.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: SAP field styling and value states for native input and textarea elements.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Overlay content anchored to a trigger, built on the CDK overlay: placements, triggers, arrow, focus handling, fill modes and resizing.

items.name: busy-indicator
items.title: Busy Indicator
items.description: Three-dot loading indicator in three sizes; wraps and blocks content while loading.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox with value states, read-only, display-only and tristate modes; a forms control.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio Button
items.description: Radio buttons with value states, read-only and wrapping labels; a forms control.

items.name: inline-help
items.title: Inline Help
items.description: Hover and focus help popover for icons, fields and buttons.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: Form header, fieldset, legend, groups, items, labels with inline help, value state messages and input message groups.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On/off switch with semantic and text variants; a forms control.

items.name: title
items.title: Title
items.description: Headings with the SAP header type scale, decoupled visual size, truncation and wrapping.

items.name: text
items.title: Text
items.description: Paragraph text with line limit, More/Less expansion, whitespace and hyphenation.

items.name: formatted-text
items.title: Formatted Text
items.description: Renders a sanitised subset of HTML.

items.name: info-label
items.title: Info Label
items.description: Non-interactive coloured labels with text, icon or number.

items.name: object-status
items.title: Object Status
items.description: Status of an object as semantic or indication-coloured text and icon, optionally inverted or clickable.

items.name: object-marker
items.title: Object Marker
items.description: Technical object states such as draft, locked or favourite as icon and/or text; clickable markers are links.

items.name: object-number
items.title: Object Number
items.description: Formatted number with unit, coloured by value state; emphasized, large, inverted or interactive.

items.name: object-identifier
items.title: Object Identifier
items.description: Object title, optionally a link, with a description below.

items.name: object-attribute
items.title: Object Attribute
items.description: Single-line object property, optionally with an action link.

items.name: generic-tag
items.title: Generic Tag
items.description: Key figure with name, value and optional status, as used in object page headers.

items.name: status-indicator
items.title: Status Indicator
items.description: SVG shapes filled to a percentage linearly, at an angle or radially, coloured by status.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Shimmering loading placeholders: rectangle, circle, text lines or custom SVG shapes.

items.name: message-strip
items.title: Message Strip
items.description: Inline contextual messages by type or indication colour; dismissible, auto-dismissing, or shown as alerts at the screen edges.

items.name: scrollbar
items.title: Scrollbar
items.description: Scroll container with SAP-themed scrollbars, registered as a CDK scrollable.

items.name: bar
items.title: Bar
items.description: Header, subheader and footer bars with left, middle and right areas, bar elements and bar buttons.
